text: The Toronto District School Board has approved the temporary relocation of Pape Avenue Junior Public School and Pape Children’s House childcare centre from 220 Langley Avenue to the Adult Learning Centre located at 540 Jones Avenue. This relocation is required to preserve a stable learning environment during major Ontario Line construction activities occurring in close proximity to the existing school site. The temporary relocation will be in effect for two academic years, from September 1, 2025 to June 30, 2027. To support safe and efficient student pick-up and drop-off operations at the new location, this report recommends temporary amendments to traffic and parking by-law regulations on Strathcona Avenue, between Jones Avenue and Blake Street, including the designation of a short-term pick-up and drop-off zone, adjustments to overnight permit parking, and the implementation of…

Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Strathcona Avenue, between Jones Avenue and Blake Street, from September 1, 2025, to June 30, 2027, inclusive. 2. Prohibited parking from 9:30 a.m. to 11:30 a.m., 1:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m., and 6:00 p.m. of one day to 7:30 a.m. of the next following day, Monday to Friday, and any time Saturday and Sunday, on the north side of Strathcona Avenue, between Jones Avenue and Blake Street, from September 1, 2025, to June 30, 2027, inclusive. 4.
